'''2007 Endor Regionals Kyle LS Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kyle]] at [[2007 Endor Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Non-Combat
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
